newsitem.title: USA: CCA Prison acquires Ohio corrections center.
newsitem.headline: CCA Prison acquires Ohio corrections center.

text.p: CCA Prison Realty Trust said Tuesday it had acquired the Northeast Ohio Correctional Center in Youngstown, Ohio from Corrections Corp of America.
CCA Realty said it will lease the medium security correctional facility back to Corrections Corp of America at an initial lease rate of 11 percent, yielding $7.7 million in annual rent.
Corrections Corp will continue to manage the facility under a 10-year, "triple net" lease, paying all operating expenses, taxes, insurance and other costs.
CCA Prison Realty Trust, based in Nashville, Tennessee, intends to qualify as a real estate investment trust under the Internal Revenue Code.
The company's business is to acquire and own correctional and detention facilities from both private prison managers and government entities.
It now owns 10 facilities including five in Texas, two in Arizona and one each in Tennessee, Kansas and Ohio.
